propositions: Closing a ticket via `rebar transition <id> in_progress closed` with verify.require_completion_verification_for_close=true reads HEAD independently during verify and sign phases, allowing concurrent commits to split them.

When HEAD drifts between verify and sign to an unrelated commit, the signer correctly refuses attestation but the close transition proceeds anyway, leaving the ticket closed without a completion signature.
The suggested recovery ('re-close to certify') is a no-op because the ticket is already closed; only --force-close or manual manifest fabrication can recover, neither of which is acceptable.
The DEFAULT code path (no --ref argument) still reads HEAD twice and remains vulnerable; the 80af --ref fix only secured the explicit-ref path.
